findings.title: Dashboard widgets emit 401 burst during SPA route transition before token rehydration
findings.evidence: Console errors observed during navigation: /api/admin/dashboard/{total-sales,total-orders,total-menu-items,realtime-report,sla-alerts,channel-statistics,audit-trail,order-statistics,sales-summary,order-summary,featured-items,popular-items} + /api/admin/fiscal/z-report ALL returned 401 during the SPA route transition window before Vuex auth.authToken was rehydrated into axios interceptors. After full page settle the widgets re-fetch successfully — observable as visible KPIs render after a ~500ms blink.
findings.impact: Noisy console for ops during multi-tab admin work + brief empty-state flash on dashboard hard-reload. No data correctness impact (refetch succeeds within sub-second). Not a security issue (401 is correct response to unauth'd request).
findings.recommendation: Defer until V1.0.2 cosmetic. Two surgical options: (a) make DashboardComponent.vue guard each axios call with `if (!this.$store.state.auth.authToken) return;` + watch authToken and refetch on rehydration; (b) raise interceptor to await Vuex rehydration before issuing parallel widget fetches. Either approach preserves zero behavior change in steady state — no fiscal/NF525 impact.

findings.title: AuditTrail widget currently shows POS cash session events only (cash.session.opened/closed/reconciled, user.login, order.created.pos, cash.movement.recorded) — order lifecycle events (order.refunded, order.status_changed, payment.captured) not visible on the dashboard sample
findings.evidence: The 50 last AuditLog rows surfaced in the dashboard widget are dominated by 13 cash.session.* + 13 user.login + 2 order.created.pos + 1 cash.movement.recorded. No order.refunded / order.status_changed / payment.* rows present in the sampled day. This may reflect either (i) no refund or status-change events occurred today, OR (ii) those event-emitters do not write to audit_logs (only ActionLog). Worth confirming in a follow-up — the widget is supposed to be a 'chain-integrity smoke proof', so the absence of full coverage of fiscal-side events reduces its inspection signal.
findings.impact: If fiscal events (refunds, status changes, NF525 close) do NOT all flow into audit_logs, the dashboard widget understates the inviolable chain's coverage breadth. Inspector reading the widget cannot tell at-a-glance if every fiscal touch is hash-chained.
findings.recommendation: Audit (read-only) AuditTrailService::log() call-sites across OrderService::refund(), OrderStateMachine transitions, PaymentComponent capture, and ZReportService::close() to confirm every fiscal-significant action writes one audit_log row. If gaps exist, V1.0.2 backlog adds them (additive, INSERT-only, no chain re-bake risk).

findings.title: ApiKeyMiddleware returns raw translated-string JSON (`"Clé API invalide."`) instead of structured envelope on 400 — front-end error handlers may treat it inconsistently
findings.evidence: Direct fetch without x-api-key header returns HTTP 400 with body `"Clé API invalide."` (a JSON-encoded bare string, not an object). All other admin error responses in this codebase use `{ status:false, message:'...' }` envelope (DashboardController::eodPdf 422 path returns `response(['status' => false, 'message' => ...], 422)`).
findings.impact: Frontend error handlers that pattern-match on `err.response.data.message` will miss this branch. The DashboardComponent::downloadEodPdf catch block (lines 236-244) reads `err.response.data` and falls back to a generic i18n label — works correctly here because the bare string is still truthy. But other call-sites may show `undefined` to the user.
findings.recommendation: V1.0.2 cosmetic: harmonize ApiKeyMiddleware to `response()->json(['status' => false, 'message' => trans('all.message.invalid_api_key')], 400)`. Zero behavior change for compliant clients; restores envelope consistency. No NF525 / fiscal / security implication.
